public_rationale: The 1997 and 2019 Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy accounts describe many connectionists as rejecting symbolic explanations of cognition, documenting that strand across more than twenty years [e1] [e2]. Both accounts also recognize connectionists who accommodate symbolic processing [e1] [e2]. The DALL·E 2 paper released on April 13, 2022 reports difficulty binding colors to objects in the prompt 'a red cube on top of a blue cube' [e3]. Together, these sources support the historical claim and the contemporary capability claim when 'elude' means unreliable rendering, rather than complete inability [e1] [e2] [e3].
limitations: The historical evidence comprises two versions of one scholarly account, not independent surveys or a count of advocates [e1] [e2].
The accounts do not establish unanimous opposition or that the same individuals maintained their positions throughout the period [e1] [e2].
The model evidence concerns DALL·E 2 and a GLIDE comparison, not an exhaustive evaluation of every system available by May 14, 2022 [e3].
GLIDE's relative advantage does not establish reliable handling of the task, and the reported difficulties do not establish complete inability [e3].

our_interpretation: The historical clause concerns a substantial strand of connectionist opposition to symbolic accounts of cognition; it does not claim unanimity among neural-network researchers.
Decades means that this position is documented over a period spanning at least twenty years, without requiring the same individuals to maintain it throughout.
In the surrounding discussion of unreliability, elude means that leading models could not reliably satisfy such compositional descriptions, not that no successful image could ever be generated.
The target period includes the unspecified earlier historical record through publication. The contemporary-performance clause is restricted to 2022 through May 14.
criteria.support_condition: Historical records establish a long-standing, substantial connectionist position opposing symbolic processing, and original contemporary evidence documents unreliable compositional rendering by a leading 2022 image model.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The historical record fails to contain the asserted substantial opposition, or contemporary evidence establishes reliable handling of the described compositional image tasks. Hybrid research and isolated successful images do not alone contradict the claim.
